title: Add source/API contract drift snapshots
summary: Add source/API contract snapshots so code↔code and KB↔code drift can be detected before validation relies on manual review.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki has deterministic source/API contract evidence that horizontal audits can consume for public facades, tool registrations, and documented package surfaces.
acceptance: Contract snapshot captures tool names, command names, public API facade exports, and package entry surfaces relevant to CodeWiki behavior.
Audit compares current source contract to documented/expected contract and produces actionable diffs.
Snapshot tests cover codewiki_roadmap naming and prevent stale internal tool names from silently reappearing.
Contract generation is deterministic and not canonical truth unless explicitly accepted.
non_goals: Do not publish or version a public API package contract beyond local audit evidence.
Do not snapshot implementation-private internals without documented ownership reason.

delta.desired: Source/API contract evidence provides deterministic drift checks for horizontal audits.
delta.current: Code↔code consistency is mostly enforced by typecheck/tests and package smoke tests.
delta.closure: Close when contract snapshots feed audit/test evidence and validation passes.
